cases.query: Show sales by channel for 2007, 2008 and 2009.
cases.notes: The SQL result for this query only has one dimension (Channel) — text-to-SQL doesn't break it out by year despite the phrasing, so this exercises the 1-dim/1-measure path, not a real 2-dim pivot. The genuine 2-dim -> GroupedBar path is covered by core-shapes.json's pivot-grouped fixture instead.

Unscoped -> spans all 3 years of ContosoRetailDW data (36 rows). Studio's SQL result denormalizes Year/Month/MonthLabel as separate columns, none of which is unique alone across years — this is the exact shape that exposed the original composite-time-axis gap.
